words.definition: Having the ability, fitness, or quality necessary to do or achieve a specified thing.
words.example: She is a highly capable leader who always solves difficult problems.

words.definition: A cash register or drawer for money in a store, bank, or restaurant.
words.example: The cashier counted the money in the till at the end of the day.

words.definition: An instrument for writing or drawing with ink.
words.example: He used a blue pen to sign the important legal document.

words.definition: A statement acknowledging the truth of something; or the process or fact of entering or being allowed to enter a place.
words.example: The museum charges a small admission fee for adult visitors.

words.definition: A covering for the foot, typically made of leather, having a sturdy sole and not reaching above the ankle.
words.example: I have a small stone stuck inside my left shoe.

words.definition: Supporting and moving someone or something from one place to another.
words.example: The workers are carrying heavy boxes into the new building.

words.definition: An act of defeating an enemy or opponent in a battle, game, or other competition.
words.example: The team celebrated their grand victory with a massive parade.

words.definition: A loose granular substance resulting from the wearing down of siliceous and other rocks.
words.example: The children built a large castle out of wet sand.

words.definition: The unlawful use of violence and intimidation, especially against civilians, in the pursuit of political aims.
words.example: The government passed new laws to help fight global terrorism.

words.definition: A feeling of great pleasure and happiness.
words.example: She jumped up and down with pure joy when she won.

words.definition: More than anything else; for the most part.
words.example: The audience consisted mainly of teenagers and young adults.

words.definition: Relating to a population subgroup with a common national or cultural tradition.
words.example: The city has a diverse mix of different ethnic groups.

words.definition: Past tense of run; moved at a speed faster than a walk.
words.example: He quickly ran to the train station to catch his ride.

words.definition: The highest legislature in certain countries, consisting of the sovereign, the House of Lords, and the House of Commons.
words.example: The members of parliament debated the new tax law for hours.

words.definition: A person whose profession is acting on the stage, in movies, or on television.
words.example: The famous actor signed autographs for his excited fans.

words.definition: A fish-eating aquatic mammal with a streamlined body and feet developed as flippers.
words.example: The playful seal swam gracefully through the cold ocean water.

words.definition: Constituting number five in a sequence.
words.example: She finished in fifth place during the difficult marathon.

words.definition: A legally recognized subject or national of a state or commonwealth.
words.example: Every adult citizen has the fundamental right to vote.

words.definition: At right angles to a horizontal plane; in a direction, or having an alignment, such that the top is directly above the bottom.
words.example: The shirt has thin vertical stripes running down the front.

words.definition: Relating to the arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of a complex whole.
words.example: The old bridge suffered severe structural damage during the storm.

words.definition: Relating to a city or town or its governing body.
words.example: The local municipal government is building a new public park.

words.definition: A thing given as a reward to the winner of a competition or race.
words.example: He won the first prize in the national science fair.

words.definition: Not qualified or diminished in any way; total.
words.example: I have absolute confidence in her ability to lead us.

words.definition: A particular kind of matter with uniform properties.
words.example: The scientists discovered a strange glowing substance in the cave.

words.definition: A tube of metal, plastic, or other material used to convey water, gas, oil, or other fluid substances.
words.example: The plumber fixed the leaking water pipe in the basement.

words.definition: A defender, protector, or keeper.
words.example: He acted as the legal guardian for his younger sister.

words.definition: An educational talk to an audience, especially to students in a university or college.
words.example: The professor gave a fascinating lecture on quantum physics.

words.definition: Imitation of a situation or process.
words.example: The pilots trained using an advanced computer flight simulation.

words.definition: Not in full health; sick.
words.example: She felt very ill after eating the strange seafood.

words.definition: The action or power of focusing one's attention or mental effort.
words.example: This difficult puzzle requires a great deal of deep concentration.

words.definition: Put down, especially gently or carefully.
words.example: Please carefully lay the fragile glass vase on the table.

words.definition: The action of explaining the meaning of something.
words.example: The professor offered a unique interpretation of the classic novel.

words.definition: Covered or marked with an unclean substance.
words.example: He washed his dirty hands before eating the fresh meal.

words.definition: A structure of planks or plates, approximately horizontal, extending across a ship or boat.
words.example: We stood on the upper deck to watch the sunset.

words.definition: Give for a good cause, for example to a charity.
words.example: Many people generously donate clothes to the local charity center.

words.definition: Past tense of teach; imparted knowledge to or instructed someone.
words.example: My grandmother taught me how to bake a delicious pie.

words.definition: The state of being completely lacking in a particular quality or value, especially financial ruin.
words.example: The failing company officially filed for legal bankruptcy last month.

words.definition: A person who does a specified type of work or who works in a specified way.
words.example: She is a hard worker who never misses a shift.

words.definition: Living, not dead.
words.example: The rescued puppy was barely alive when they found him.

words.definition: A building devoted to the worship, or regarded as the dwelling place, of a god or gods or other objects of religious reverence.
words.example: Tourists silently explored the beautiful ancient stone temple.

words.definition: Demonstrate the truth or existence of something by evidence or argument.
words.example: He had to prove his innocence to the strict judge.

words.definition: Relating to genes or heredity.
words.example: The rare disease is caused by a complex genetic mutation.

words.definition: A declaration or assurance that one will do a particular thing or that a particular thing will happen.
words.example: He made a sincere promise to always help his friends.

words.definition: Having opposite surfaces or sides close together; of little thickness or depth.
words.example: He sliced the fresh bread into very thin, even pieces.

words.definition: A public display of works of art or items of interest, held in an art gallery or museum.
words.example: The art gallery hosted a beautiful new photography exhibition.

words.definition: Like one thing or person better than another or others; tend to choose.
words.example: I usually prefer drinking cold water instead of hot tea.

words.definition: A long, narrow hilltop, mountain range, or watershed.
words.example: The brave hikers carefully walked along the sharp mountain ridge.

words.definition: A cupboard with drawers or shelves for storing or displaying articles.
words.example: She placed the clean dishes neatly into the wooden cabinet.

words.definition: Affected by physical or mental illness.
words.example: He stayed home from work because he was feeling sick.

words.definition: A quantity of a medicine or drug taken or recommended to be taken at a particular time.
words.example: The doctor prescribed a daily dose of important vitamins.

words.definition: Form an idea of the amount, number, or value of; assess.
words.example: The teacher will evaluate the students based on their essays.

words.definition: A thin, transparent silk or cotton fabric.
words.example: The elegant dress was crafted using a delicate tiffany fabric.

words.definition: Of, typical of, or peculiar to the tropics.
words.example: They enjoyed a relaxing vacation on a warm tropical island.

words.definition: Bring or gather together.
words.example: We plan to collect enough firewood for the cold evening.

words.definition: An agreement to risk money on the unknown outcome of an event.
words.example: He placed a small bet on the fast racing horse.

words.definition: The nature of something's ingredients or constituents; the way in which a whole or mixture is made up.
words.example: Scientists carefully analyzed the chemical composition of the mysterious rock.

words.definition: A quantity having direction as well as magnitude, especially as determining the position of one point in space relative to another.
words.example: The pilot calculated the precise wind vector before landing safely.

words.definition: Without doubt.
words.example: I will definitely finish reading the book by tomorrow morning.

words.definition: A place where a road branches off from another.
words.example: Take the first turning on the left to reach home.

words.definition: A person or thing that prevents incompatible or antagonistic people or things from coming into contact with or harming each other.
words.example: The soft foam acts as a buffer against hard impacts.

words.definition: Of a color intermediate between red and blue.
words.example: She wore a bright purple dress to the fancy party.

words.definition: The fact or state of living or having objective reality.
words.example: Many people debate the existence of life on other planets.

words.definition: An expression of opinions or offering of explanations about an event or situation.
words.example: The sports announcer provided exciting live commentary during the game.

words.definition: A large, heavy motor vehicle for transporting goods or troops; a truck.
words.example: A huge lorry delivered fresh supplies to the local supermarket.

words.definition: The action of coming to live permanently in a foreign country.
words.example: The airport immigration officer carefully checked her newly issued passport.

words.definition: Held in common by two or more parties.
words.example: They reached an agreement based on deep mutual respect.

words.definition: As a necessary result; inevitably.
words.example: Bigger does not necessarily mean better when choosing a car.

words.definition: The arrangement of words and phrases to create well-formed sentences in a language.
words.example: Learning the complex syntax of a new language takes time.

words.definition: Regard something as being caused by someone or something.
words.example: They attribute their immense success to hard work and dedication.

words.definition: A building in which people are legally held as a punishment for a crime they have committed or while awaiting trial.
words.example: The thief was sent to prison for his terrible crimes.

words.definition: The ability to do something well; expertise.
words.example: Playing the piano beautifully requires a lot of musical skill.

words.definition: Commonplace or normal.
words.example: The soft jeans are perfect for casual everyday wear.

words.definition: As far as one knows or can see.
words.example: Apparently, it is supposed to rain heavily all day tomorrow.

words.definition: All around a particular place or thing.
words.example: The surrounding mountains were completely covered in thick white snow.

words.definition: The state or condition of being liked, admired, or supported by many people.
words.example: The band's popularity grew rapidly after their first major concert.

words.definition: An act of asking for information.
words.example: The police launched an official inquiry into the mysterious robbery.

words.definition: Manifest or deliberately display a quality or a type of behavior.
words.example: The rare animals exhibit strange behavior during the cold winter.

words.definition: Propel something with force through the air by a movement of the arm and hand.
words.example: Please throw the red ball directly back to me now.

words.definition: A general direction in which something is developing or changing.
words.example: There is a growing trend toward eating healthy, organic food.

words.definition: A long jagged mountain chain.
words.example: They spent the summer hiking through the beautiful high sierra.

words.definition: Able to be seen.
words.example: The bright stars were clearly visible in the dark sky.

words.definition: A barren area of landscape where little precipitation occurs.
words.example: Camels can travel for many days across the hot desert.

words.definition: A heavy silvery-white metal that is liquid at ordinary temperatures.
words.example: The old glass thermometer contained a small drop of mercury.

words.definition: Sound that is directed through two or more speakers so that it seems to surround the listener.
words.example: He played loud music on his brand new car stereo.

words.definition: A book giving information such as facts on a particular subject or instructions for operating a machine.
words.example: Please read the employee handbook before starting your first day.

words.definition: Plan and direct the route or course of a ship, aircraft, or other form of transport.
words.example: We used a map to carefully navigate the dark forest.

words.definition: Of poorer quality or lower standard; more bad or severe.
words.example: The weather is much worse today than it was yesterday.

words.definition: The highest point of a hill or mountain.
words.example: The climbers proudly planted a flag at the snowy summit.

words.definition: Forming a necessary base or core; of central importance.
words.example: Freedom of speech is a fundamental human right.

words.definition: Very hot or bright.
words.example: The burning sun made everyone feel extremely tired and thirsty.

words.definition: Break free from confinement or control.
words.example: The quick rabbit managed to safely escape from the hungry fox.

words.definition: To a moderate extent or by a moderate amount.
words.example: The difficult math test was somewhat easier than I expected.

words.definition: The piece of a radio or television set that receives broadcast signals, or the part of a telephone used to listen.
words.example: She picked up the telephone receiver to answer the call.

words.definition: Of considerable importance, size, or worth.
words.example: The company donated a substantial amount of money to charity.

words.definition: Happening or developing gradually or in stages; proceeding step by step.
words.example: The patient showed slow but progressive improvement after the surgery.

words.definition: Take a brief or hurried look.
words.example: He took a quick glance at his watch during the meeting.

words.definition: Relating to Scotland or its people.
words.example: The man wore a traditional Scottish kilt to the festival.

words.definition: A contest for the position of champion in a sport, often involving a series of games or matches.
words.example: The brave team proudly won the national football championship trophy.

words.definition: A covered passageway with arches along one or both sides; or a venue with coin-operated games.
words.example: The children spent all their coins at the gaming arcade.

words.definition: Not able to occur, exist, or be done.
words.example: It is nearly impossible to solve this incredibly difficult puzzle.
